brief:
The Jerusalem electricity authority faces mounting challenges as it approaches 2026, according to Ma'an Wire. The timeframe marks a critical juncture for the power system serving the occupied city, with infrastructure and supply concerns mounting.

Details of the specific pressures and proposed solutions remain unclear from available reporting. The situation reflects broader energy challenges affecting Palestinian and Israeli populations in the Jerusalem area.
title: Jerusalem's electricity crisis deepens as 2026 deadline looms
